composition_variation: Create a luxurious original anime summer illustration of adult Ningguang, recognizable by flowing white hair, ruby-red eyes, and delicate gold hair ornaments. Give her a serene beautiful face and a quietly delighted expression. She wears an opaque ivory sleeveless blouse, tailored but relaxed pale-gold summer shorts, understated jewelry, and comfortable sandals. Capture a graceful turning step on a garden footbridge, with both hands gently holding a broad sunhat in front of her waist and her hair moving in the breeze. The pose is assured and lively without exposing undergarments or emphasizing anatomy. Use ivory, warm gold, jade-green foliage, and sunlit osmanthus blossoms. One adult woman in an everyday nonviolent scene. Keep the upper quarter airy and uncluttered; set her head near forty percent height and all key gestures within the central crop.
